completed.title: 2.5 SSE escalation stream for operator console
completed.purpose: AI can accelerate every OODA phase, but Boyd's orientation includes judgment that pattern-matching alone cannot replace. This capability defines structured sensemaking checkpoints, approval tokens for irreversible actions, and escalation paths.
completed.requirement: The runtime SHALL escalate to human review when confidence, contradictions, risk budget, or approval requirements fail.
completed.gherkin:
Scenario: Escalate on contradiction review

  GIVEN `requires_human_review` is true due to orientation contradictions
  WHEN Orient completes
  THEN the runtime SHALL pause before Decide
  AND escalation payload SHALL include world model snapshot, contradictions, and audit correlation id

inWork.title: Schwerpunkt: Boyd OODA orientation-first agent platform
inWork.purpose: Executable demo and test scenarios derived from Boyd OODA Grok concept tickets. Each scenario maps to `fixtures/scenarios/*.json`, optional `fixtures/cognition/<scenario>/`, and Gherkin in `features/runtime-modes.feature`.
inWork.requirement: The contradiction_case scenario SHALL seed a closed case and observe an open signal for operator resolution.
inWork.gherkin:
Scenario: Operator demo contradiction flow

  GIVEN fixture `fixtures/scenarios/contradiction_case.json`
  AND `SCHWERKPUNKT_MODE=manual`
  WHEN the operator loads the fixture and advances the loop
  THEN the runtime SHALL pause with `pending_operator.kind=orient`
  WHEN the operator resolves `case_status` to `open`
  THEN contradictions SHALL be cleared
  AND the loop SHALL proceed toward Decide without LLM or MCP

inWork.title: Phase 1: filter mark-changed UX polish
inWork.purpose: The home screen SHALL show only items that need family action soon — overdue or upcoming filters, expiring warranties, and due service — sorted with the most urgent first.
inWork.requirement: The system SHALL include filter schedules within 14 days of due (including overdue) on the attention list.
inWork.gherkin:
Scenario: Overdue filter appears first
  GIVEN a filter overdue by 10 days and another due in 5 days
  WHEN the attention list is built
  THEN the overdue item SHALL appear before the soon item

next.title: Phase 1: add warranty/service forms
next.purpose: Households SHALL be able to keep a plain-language list of appliances with room and type so family members can find the right machine without serial numbers.
next.requirement: The system SHALL store an appliance with a human name, kind, and room.
next.gherkin:
Scenario: Add named appliance
  GIVEN an empty or existing household
  WHEN a user adds an appliance named "Kitchen fridge" of kind refrigerator in the kitchen
  THEN the appliance SHALL appear in the appliance list
  AND its detail page SHALL be reachable by id

completed.title: verified-xfer-initial
completed.purpose: Operators need to move test inputs onto a Linux share, run an external system under test, then pull results and logs back — with proof that every file landed in the right place.
completed.requirement: The tool SHALL load YAML configuration from an ordered search path and SHALL always print which file was chosen.
completed.gherkin:
Scenario: System-wide Windows lab config

  GIVEN no `--config` flag and no `./config.yaml`
  AND `%PROGRAMDATA%\verified-xfer\config.yaml` exists
  WHEN the operator runs `stage` or `retrieve`
  THEN the tool loads that system-wide file
  AND the log includes `CONFIG | source=…` and `CONFIG | path=…`
